name: 85262 · Scottsdale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85262 (Scottsdale) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85262 (Scottsdale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
